## 简体中文

### 亮点

- 新增根据网关标识自动切换代理路径，并可在控制 UI 中配置网络切换。
- 新增 Windows DNS 捕获、可配置的 DNS-over-TLS 上游，以及更安全的 FakeIP/IPv6 行为。
- 新增可取消的核心下载和异步运行重启进度。
- 改进 Windows 安装、升级、卸载和提权命令可靠性。
- 改进 macOS 网络服务检测和安装兼容性。

### 最终构建修复

- 正确将所选核心安装标记为正在使用。
- 不适用时隐藏家庭网络摘要。
- 避免本地代理、DNS 监听器和运行端口冲突。
- 主机没有可用 IPv6 路由时优先通过 IPv4 下载。
- 协调控制 UI 中的浮层滚动锁定。

### 构建与发布

- 并行执行跨平台构建并复用已验证的发布输入，加快 GitHub Release 构建。
- Windows、macOS 和 Linux 产物包含签名的构建来源证明、CycloneDX SBOM 和 SHA-256 校验和。

- [完整更新记录](https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v2.0.7...v2.0.8)

## English

### Highlights

- Added automatic proxy-path switching by gateway identity, with configurable network switching in the control UI.
- Added Windows DNS capture with configurable DNS-over-TLS upstreams and safer FakeIP/IPv6 behavior.
- Added cancellable core downloads and asynchronous runtime restart progress.
- Improved Windows installation, upgrade, uninstall, and elevated-command reliability.
- Improved macOS network-service detection and installation compatibility.

### Fixes in the final build

- Correctly marks the selected core installation as in use.
- Hides the home-network summary when it is not applicable.
- Avoids local proxy, DNS listener, and runtime port conflicts.
- Prefers IPv4 downloads when the host has no usable IPv6 route.
- Coordinates overlay scroll locking in the control UI.

### Build and release

- Parallelized cross-platform builds and reused verified release inputs for faster GitHub releases.
- Includes signed build provenance, CycloneDX SBOMs, and SHA-256 checksums for Windows, macOS, and Linux artifacts.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v2.0.7...v2.0.8
